summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AMSA Document Management System. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend UI functional with minor Select component issue fixed. Document upload, filtering, search, and CRUD operations all working as expected.

integration_issues.workaround: Using force=True for button clicks resolves the issue

Access control (Edit and Full access levels)
Frontend document list display with vessel indicators
